result.question: What warning did Zebul send to Abimelech about Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers?

readings.answer: That Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers had come to Shechem and were stirring up the city against him.
readings.support: Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you

assessments.reason: Matches 9:31 exactly: “Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you,” which is the same content as the key.

result.reason: Verse 9:31 directly states Zebul’s warning that Gaal and his brothers had come to Shechem and were stirring up the city against Abimelech.
